## Overview

Writing code that's easy to understand and reuse, by others and by yourself months later is at the heart of RAP. 

In this session, you'll learn to write modular functions, document your functions, and follow consistent style conventions that make your work easy to read.

## 🎯 Learning objectives

By the end of this session, you should be able to:

- Recognise and refactor repeated code into into reusable functions 
- Write clear function documentation
- Use comments effectively (and know when NOT to comment)
- Follow a consistent code style and use automated tools to enforce it
- Structure your project files for clarity and maintainability

## 📖 Before the session

Please complete the [pre-learning materials](pre-learning.qmd). These typically take 60 – 90 minutes and are essential for getting the most out of the session.
